blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Unified 3D vision-language systems must combine complementary geometry, scale, and appearance cues while supporting tasks from instance segmentation to language-guided reasoning. Existing methods often process point clouds, voxel grids, and multi-view images independently; directly combining these heterogeneous representations may leave substantial feature discrepancy unresolved, while subsequent unconstrained adaptation may distort their internal geometry. We propose an “ align-then-fuse " framework that first applies triple pairwise cosine alignment to establish segment-level correspondence across the three representations and then retrieves task-conditioned features with a prompt-guided query decoder. Before fusion, representation-specific query features are transformed by learnable mappings constrained to the special orthogonal group. These mappings preserve inner products and Euclidean distances within each representation, permitting controlled representation-specific re-parameterisation without arbitrarily distorting its internal geometry. The transformed features are subsequently combined through Adaptive Fusion under downstream task supervision. Experiments cover eight datasets for instance segmentation, visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning. Compared with PQ3D, the model improves average precision by 3.2 points on ScanNet200 and grounding accuracy by 2.9, 10.6, 4.6, and 4.1 points on ScanRefer, Nr3D, Sr3D, and Multi3DRefer, respectively, while also improving performance on ScanQA, SQA3D, and Scan2Cap. Ablations further support the complementary roles of alignment and orthogonal re-parameterisation and the effectiveness of Adaptive Fusion.
blocks.zh: 统一的3D视觉语言系统必须结合互补的几何、尺度和外观提示,同时支持从实例分割到语言指导推理的任务。 现有方法往往会独立处理点云,voxel网格,以及多视图图像;直接结合这些多样的表示可能留下大量特征差异未解决,而随后的不受约束的适应可能扭曲其内部几何. 我们建议采用 " 调和时调和 " 框架,首先采用三对齐的余弦调和法,在三个代表处建立分层对应,然后检索附有任务条件的特征,并使用快速指导的查询解码器。 在聚变之前,代表特异性查询特征通过受特殊正交组制约的可学习绘图而转变. 这些绘图保存了内产物和每个代表物中的欧几里得距离,允许在不任意扭曲其内部几何的情况下进行控制下的特定代表物重新参数化。 随后,通过在下游任务监督下的适应性融合,将转变的特征结合起来。 实验涵盖8个数据集,例如分块、视觉地面、问答和密集字幕。 与PQ3D相比,该型号在ScanNet200上提高了平均精度3.2分,在ScanRefer,Nr3D,Sr3D,和Multi3Drefer上分别提高了2.9,10.6,4.6和4.1分,同时也提高了ScanQA,SQA3D和Scan2Cap上的性能. 配位进一步支持配位和正体再配位的互补作用以及适应融合的有效性.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: In real-world scenarios, achieving a joint understanding of 3D environments and natural language is essential for constructing agents with practical operational abilities [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . In recent years, with the continuous development of 3D vision-language tasks and their related datasets, significant progress has been made in areas ranging from fundamental 3D semantic and instance segmentation [ 8 , 9 ] to visual grounding [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] , 3D question answering [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] , 3D dense captioning [ 18 ] , and open-vocabulary 3D understanding [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 在现实世界中,实现对三维环境和自然语言的共同理解对于建设具有实际操作能力的代理人[1、2、3、4、5、6、7]至关重要。 近年来,随着3D视觉语言任务及其相关数据集的不断发展,从基本的3D语义和实例分解[8,9]到视觉地基[10,11,12,13,14],3D问题回答[15,16,17],3D稠密字幕[18],以及开放的3D理解[19,20,21,22]等领域都取得了显著进展.

blocks.en:
Previous research often employed task-specific models built on a single type of 3D representation [ 23 , 15 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] , while more recent studies increasingly incorporate multiple scene representations within shared 3D vision-language frameworks [ 7 , 28 , 29 ] . Earlier multimodal 3D methods demonstrated the benefit of combining image and 3D information through spatial projection, feature augmentation, or cross-modal interaction [ 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] . More recent approaches address representation heterogeneity more explicitly. Inst3D-LMM integrates multi-view semantics with matched 3D instances [ 36 ] , while DSPNet selects question-relevant views before combining image and point-cloud features [ 37 ] . CrossOver maps heterogeneous scene modalities into a shared embedding space [ 38 ] , whereas CUA-O3D and Proxy3D reduce feature heterogeneity through uncertainty-aware knowledge aggregation [ 39 ] and semantic-aware proxy construction [ 40 ] , respectively.
These developments establish increasingly effective connections among heterogeneous scene representations, but the underlying features are still generated by representation-specific encoding processes before being jointly used for prediction. Consequently, incorporating these heterogeneous representations into a shared prediction architecture does not by itself ensure their latent compatibility before joint prediction.
blocks.zh:
以往的研究往往采用基于单一类型三维代表制[23、15、24、25、26、27]的具体任务模型,而最近的研究越来越多地将多个场景代表制纳入共享三维远景语言框架[7、28、29]。 早先的多式联运三维方法表明,通过空间投影、特征增强或跨模式互动将图像和三维信息结合起来的好处[30、31、32、33、34、35]。 最近的办法更明确地处理代表性的异质性。 Inst3D-LMM将多视图语义与匹配的3D实例[36]集成,而DSPNet则在将图像和点云特性集成[37]之前选择与问题相关的视图. 交叉 将不同场景模式映射到共享嵌入空间[38],而CUA-O3D和Proxy3D则分别通过不确定性-认知知识聚合[39]和语义-认知代理构建[40]减少特征异质性.
这些发展在各种场景表现之间建立了日益有效的联系,但是在共同用于预测之前,其基本特征仍然由特定表现的编码过程产生。 因此,将这些不同的表述纳入共同的预测结构本身并不能确保它们在共同预测之前的潜在兼容性。

blocks.en: To address this issue, we propose an “ align-then-fuse ” framework for multi-representation 3D vision-language understanding. Because features produced by different encoders can remain misaligned before joint prediction, we first introduce Triple Alignment to enforce pairwise cosine correspondence among spatially matched point-cloud, voxel, and multi-view features before prompt-guided decoding. Alignment improves cross-representation correspondence, while the aligned features still retain representation-specific parameterizations before fusion. However, unconstrained transformations may arbitrarily alter the geometry already encoded within each feature space. We therefore constrain each representation-specific mapping to the special orthogonal group SO ⁡ ( D ) \mathrm{SO}(D) . The resulting transformations preserve pairwise Euclidean distances and inner products within each representation while permitting learnable re-parameterisation. Finally, the transformed features are combined through Adaptive Fusion and jointly optimized under downstream task supervision. Experiments on various benchmarks spanning instance segmentation, visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning demonstrate broad improvements over the displayed baselines and support the effectiveness of explicitly aligning heterogeneous representations before their controlled adaptation and fusion.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个“协调”框架,促进多代表的三维愿景语言理解。 由于不同编码器产生的特性在联合预测前仍会保持错位,所以我们首先引入三联调制,在空间匹配的点-云,voxel,以及多视图特性之间强制进行对映对映,然后进行即时导解码. 对齐改进了跨表示式对应,而对齐式特征在聚变前仍保留了代表式特定参数化. 然而,不受约束的转换可能任意改变每个特征空间内已经编码的几何. 因此,我们把每个特定代表的映射限制在特殊的正交组SO(D)\phrm{SO}(D)。 由此产生的变异保存了每种代表物中的双向Euclidean距离和内产物,同时允许可学习的重新参数化。 最后,通过适应性融合将转变后的特性结合起来,并在下游任务监督下联合优化。 关于各种基准的实验,包括实例分解、目视定位、问答和密集的字幕,这些试验表明,在显示的基线上,有了广泛的改进,并支持在有控制的适应和组合之前,明确调整各种表述的有效性。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are fourfold:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献有四重:

blocks.en: • We investigate two closely related challenges in unified 3D vision-language learning: representation heterogeneity before joint modeling and latent-basis discrepancy during cross-representation fusion. • To address representation heterogeneity, we introduce Triple Alignment to establish explicit pairwise correspondence among spatially matched point-cloud, voxel, and multi-view features. • To address latent-basis discrepancy during fusion, we introduce representation-specific orthogonal re-parameterisation based on SO ⁡ ( D ) \mathrm{SO}(D) , allowing learnable adaptation while preserving intra-representation geometry, followed by Adaptive Fusion. • We evaluate our approach on eight 3D vision–language datasets: ScanNet200 [ 8 ] for instance segmentation; ScanRefer [ 12 ] , ReferIt3D (Nr3D and Sr3D) [ 11 ] , and Multi3DRefer [ 14 ] for visual localization; ScanQA [ 15 ] and SQA3D [ 16 ] for question answering; and Scan2Cap [ 18 ] for dense description. In extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method outperforms the baseline.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Query-Based 3D Vision-Language Learning
blocks.zh: II-A 查询基于3D 视觉语言学习

blocks.en: 3D vision-language learning has expanded from individual perception tasks to a broad range of language-conditioned scene understanding problems, including segmentation [ 8 , 41 ] , visual grounding [ 10 , 11 , 23 , 12 , 14 ] , question answering [ 15 , 16 ] , and dense captioning [ 18 ] . Early methods were predominantly developed for individual tasks, with task-specific architectures and prediction heads tailored to different forms of 3D perception and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 3D视觉语言学习已经从个人感知任务扩展到了广泛的语言条件的场景理解问题,包括分化[8,41],视觉地面[10,11,23,12,14],问题回答[15,16],以及密集的字幕[18]. 早期的方法主要是针对个别任务开发的,有针对特定任务的架构和预测头,适合不同形式的3D感知和推理.

blocks.en: Query-based prediction provides a natural route toward a more unified formulation. Originating from set-based object prediction [ 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 ] , query representations have been extended to mask prediction [ 47 ] , language-guided segmentation [ 48 , 49 ] , and multimodal prediction [ 50 , 51 , 52 , 53 , 54 ] . Rather than defining a separate prediction mechanism for each task, latent queries interact with visual representations and can be conditioned by different forms of prompts, providing a shared interface between input guidance and downstream outputs.
blocks.zh: 基于查询的预测为更统一的配体提供了自然的路径. 源于设定对象预测[42,43,44,45,46],查询表示法被扩展为遮掩预测[47],语言引导分解[48,49],以及多式联运预测[50,51,52,53,54]. 潜在的查询不是为每项任务确定单独的预测机制,而是与视觉表达相互作用,并且可以不同形式的提示作为条件,在输入指导和下游输出之间提供一个共享的接口。

blocks.en: This paradigm has subsequently been adopted in 3D scene understanding. OpenMask3D [ 22 ] , OpenScene [ 55 ] , PLA [ 56 ] , and Mosaic3D [ 41 ] associate 3D regions or proposals with vision-language representations for open-vocabulary recognition and segmentation. More recent methods extend query-based interaction beyond category-level prediction toward language-conditioned scene understanding. LL3DA [ 29 ] introduces language-guided interaction with 3D scene features, while PQ3D [ 28 ] employs a shared set of promptable queries to accommodate multiple 3D vision-language tasks within a common prediction framework. These developments mark a transition from task-specific 3D vision-language pipelines toward query-based formulations in which diverse prediction objectives can be expressed through a shared interaction mechanism.
blocks.zh: 这个范式后来在3D场景理解中被采用. OpenMassk3D [22],OpenScene [55],PLA [56],以及Mosaic3D [41] 将3D区域或提案与视觉语言表述联系起来,用于开放式的省道识别和分区. 较新的方法将基于查询的交互作用扩展到了类别层次的预测之外,以达到语言条件的场景理解. LL3DA[29]引入了语言引导与3D场景特征的交互,而PQ3D[28]则使用一套共享的快速查询,以适应在共同预测框架内的多个3D视觉语言任务. 这些事态发展标志着从针对特定任务的三维远景语言管道向基于查询的配方的过渡,在这种配方中,可以通过共同的互动机制表达不同的预测目标。

blocks.en: II-B 3D Multimodal Fusion
blocks.zh: II-B 3D 多式联运组合

blocks.en: Point clouds, voxel grids, and multi-view images provide complementary descriptions of a 3D scene. Point clouds preserve detailed geometric observations, voxel grids impose regular spatial structure, and multi-view images provide dense appearance information. These representations, however, arise from different sampling processes and are typically processed by independently designed encoders, resulting in representation-specific feature spaces with no inherent guarantee of latent compatibility.
blocks.zh: 点云,voxel网格,以及多视图图像为3D场景提供了互补描述. 点云保留了详细的几何观测,voxel网格施加了规律的空间结构,多视图图像提供了密集的外观信息. 然而,这些表示来自不同的采样过程,通常由独立设计的编码器处理,从而产生具有特定表示特征的空间,而不存在固有的潜在兼容性保证。

blocks.en: Earlier multimodal 3D methods project image features into a shared spatial representation for intermediate fusion [ 30 , 31 ] , or augment point features with image-derived semantic and appearance cues [ 32 , 33 ] . Subsequent approaches introduce cross-modal attention and deformable interaction to support more flexible information exchange between image and 3D representations [ 34 , 35 , 57 , 58 , 59 ] . These methods demonstrate the effectiveness of combining complementary representations, although their interaction mechanisms are typically developed around a particular representation pair or downstream setting.
blocks.zh: 早期的多式联运三维方法将图像特征投射为中间聚变的共享空间代表[30,31],或带有图像衍生语义和外观提示的增强点特征[32,33]. 随后的方法引入了跨模式关注和变形互动,以支持图像和三维表达[34、35、57、58、59]之间更为灵活的信息交流。 这些方法表明将互补表述结合起来是有效的,尽管其互动机制通常是围绕特定的表述对或下游环境形成的。

blocks.en: More recent studies address representation heterogeneity more explicitly. Inst3D-LMM [ 36 ] injects multi-view semantics into matched 3D instances and models their spatial relations, whereas DSPNet [ 37 ] selects question-relevant views before integrating image and point-cloud features. CrossOver [ 38 ] maps multiple, potentially incomplete scene modalities into a shared embedding space, while CUA-O3D [ 39 ] and Proxy3D [ 40 ] reduce feature heterogeneity through uncertainty-aware knowledge aggregation and semantic-aware proxy construction, respectively. These approaches provide effective mechanisms for connecting heterogeneous scene observations, but the resulting features are still produced by representation-specific encoding processes before being combined for prediction. Consequently, their latent compatibility is not guaranteed by the shared prediction architecture itself. This motivates an explicit treatment of feature compatibility before joint prediction, together with a controlled mechanism for adapting and combining heterogeneous representations without unnecessarily altering the structure already encoded within each feature space.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究更明确地讨论了代表性的异质性。 Inst3D-LMM [36] 在匹配的3D实例和模型中注入多视图语义,而DSPNet [37] 在集成图像和点云特性之前选择与问题相关的视图. Cross Over [38] 将多种,可能不完整的场景模式映射到共享嵌入空间中,而CUA-O3D [39] 和Proxy3D [40] 则分别通过不确定性认知集合和语义认知代理构建来降低特征异性. 这些方法为连接各种场景观测提供了有效的机制,但由此产生的特征仍然通过特定代表编码过程产生,然后才进行合并预测。 因此,共同预测架构本身无法保证它们的潜在兼容性。 这促使在联合预测之前明确处理地物兼容性,同时建立一个可控机制,在不必要地改变每个地物空间内已经编码的结构的情况下,调整和合并各种表达方式。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Architecture of the proposed “ align-then-fuse ” framework. Point-cloud, voxel, and multi-view image features are first coordinated through Triple Alignment to establish cross-representation correspondence. The resulting representation-specific features are then adapted by orthogonal re-parameterisation, which preserves their intra-representation geometry, and combined through Adaptive Fusion. The fused representation is subsequently conditioned on the task prompt and processed by the multi-task prediction heads for downstream 3D vision-language tasks.
blocks.zh: 图3:拟议“当时一致”框架的结构。 点-云,voxel,和多视图图像特征首先通过三对齐协调,建立交叉表示的对应. 由此而来的代表特异性特征再由正体再参数化调整,保留其代表内几何,并通过适应性融合进行组合. 引信的表示随后以任务即时为条件,由下游3D视觉语言任务的多任务预测负责人处理.

blocks.en: III Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 三. 初步情况

blocks.en: Task Prompt Encoding. We formulate different 3D vision-language tasks using unified task prompts of two types: textual prompts, including object categories, referring expressions, and questions; and numerical prompts, including 3D bounding boxes and 3D locations. Textual prompts are encoded using a pretrained CLIP model [ 60 ] , while numerical prompts are projected to the same hidden dimension through learnable fully connected layers. The resulting prompt features provide task-specific conditioning for downstream prediction.
blocks.zh: 任务快速编码 。 我们使用两种类型的统一任务提示来制定不同的3D视觉语言任务:文本提示,包括对象类别,引用表达式,和问题;数字提示,包括3D边框和3D位置. 文字提示使用事先训练的CLIP模型[60]编码,而数字提示通过可学习的全连接层投射到相同的隐藏维度. 由此产生的即时特征为下游预测提供了具体任务的条件。

blocks.en: Multi-Representation 3D Encoding. To encode a 3D scene, three representations are considered: point clouds, voxel grids, and multi-view images. For point clouds, the entire set of 3D points is partitioned into segments. In each segment, 1,024 points are sampled and normalized to a unit sphere. These points are processed through a pretrained PointNet++ backbone [ 61 , 62 ] to obtain point features 𝒫 = { p 1 , p 2 , … , p M } ∈ ℝ M × D \mathcal{P}=\{p_{1},p_{2},\dots,p_{M}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times D} , where M M denotes the number of segments. Voxel features are extracted by discretizing the 3D scene into voxels. The voxel grid is processed with a sparse convolutional U-Net that includes both downsampling and upsampling stages to capture hierarchical details. Features from each voxel are pooled to their corresponding segments and projected into the hidden dimension to form 𝒱 = { v 1 , v 2 , … , v M } ∈ ℝ M × D \mathcal{V}=\{v_{1},v_{2},\dots,v_{M}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times D} . Multi-view image features are derived by computing per-pixel embeddings using a pretrained segmentation model (e.g., OpenSeg [ 63 ] ). The 2D pixels are back-projected into the 3D space, and features from multiple views are averaged to form image features ℐ = { i 1 , i 2 , … , i M } ∈ ℝ M × D \mathcal{I}=\{i_{1},i_{2},\dots,i_{M}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times D} .

blocks.zh: 四 方法

blocks.en: IV-A Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 四-A 问题的提出

blocks.en: • Modal heterogeneity. Prior work [ 28 , 29 ] employs prompt-based queries to extract features from point clouds, multi-scale voxels, and multi-view images. These representations are typically processed in parallel and are either selected according to downstream tasks or mapped into a shared feature space. However, as shown in Figure 2 , different representations exhibit distinct feature distributions even for the same scene, revealing a persistent discrepancy among heterogeneous representations. This motivates explicit feature alignment before their joint use. • Latent-basis discrepancy. Alignment alone does not require independently encoded representations to share the same latent parameterization. After alignment, representation-specific adaptation can therefore still be beneficial to retain the flexibility of individual representations before fusion. We refer to this remaining mismatch between independently parameterized feature spaces as latent-basis discrepancy. Applying unconstrained transformations at this stage, however, may arbitrarily distort their encoded feature geometry. We therefore seek a constrained re-parameterisation that can adapt each representation-specific feature space while preserving its internal geometric structure.
blocks.zh: • 潮汐异质性。 先前的工作[28,29]使用即时的查询从点云,多尺度的voxels,以及多视图图像中提取特征. 这些表述通常平行处理,或者根据下游任务加以选择,或者绘制成共同的特征空间。 然而,如图2所示,不同的表述甚至在同一场景中也显示出不同的特征分布,表明不同表述之间持续存在差异。 这促使在共同使用之前明确调整特征。 • 后期基础差异。 单靠对齐不需要独立编码的表示来共享相同的潜在参数化. 因此,在调整后,针对代表的调整仍然有利于在合并之前保持个人表述的灵活性。 我们把独立参数化特征空间之间仍然存在的这种不匹配现象称为潜在基础差异。 然而,在现阶段应用不受限制的转换可能任意扭曲其编码的特征几何学。 因此,我们寻求一种限制性的重新参数化,既可以调整每个代表特性空间,又可以保留其内部几何结构。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we adopt an “ align-then-fuse ” strategy. We first explicitly align the features of point-cloud, voxel, and multi-view image representations. The resulting features are then adapted through representation-specific orthogonal re-parameterisation, which permits learnable transformation while preserving pairwise geometry within each representation. The adapted features are subsequently combined through Adaptive Fusion, yielding a fused scene representation that is passed to the multi-task prediction heads for downstream prediction. The overall formulation therefore separates cross-representation correspondence from representation-specific adaptation, allowing heterogeneous 3D features to be coordinated without unconstrained distortion before fusion.

blocks.en: IV-C Orthogonal Fusion with Re-parameterisation
blocks.zh: IV-C 矫形与再参数化

blocks.en: Although Triple Alignment improves correspondence among the three representations, the queried features are still generated through independently parameterized representation streams. Directly applying unconstrained linear adapters before fusion may introduce arbitrary scaling, shearing, and anisotropic distortion, thereby altering the internal feature geometry of each stream. We therefore restrict the modality-specific adapters to the special orthogonal group SO ⁡ ( D ) \mathrm{SO}(D) . This design does not assume that the residual cross-representation discrepancy is generated by a rotation. Instead, orthogonality serves as a geometry-preserving constraint that allows each representation to be adaptively re-parameterized without changing its internal pairwise structure.
blocks.zh: 虽然三重排列改善了三个表述之间的对应关系,但被询问的特征仍然通过独立的参数化表述流产生. 在聚变前直接应用不受约束的线性适配器可能引入任意的缩放,剪切,以及异位扭曲,从而改变每个流的内部特征几何. 因此,我们将特定模式的适配器限制在特殊的正交组 SO(D)\ mathrm{SO}(D) 。 这一设计并不认为剩余的交叉表示差异是轮调造成的。 反之,矫形是一种几何保存的制约,它使每种表示都能够适应性地重新参数化,而不改变其内部对称结构。

We apply orthogonal re-parameterisation to the three query-conditioned features and subsequently combine them through adaptive fusion. The fused query representation is then passed to the subsequent query decoding and task-specific prediction heads.

Triple Alignment thus provides explicit pre-fusion correspondence, while the fused task objective provides implicit task-driven coordination among the transformed representations.

blocks.en: We evaluate models on eight public benchmarks spanning four task families. ScanNet200 [ 8 ] supplies instance masks, evaluated with AP, AP 50 , AP 25 , and head/common/tail category AP. ScanRefer [ 12 ] , Nr3D [ 11 ] , Sr3D [ 11 ] , and Multi3DRefer [ 14 ] evaluate language-guided localization with their standard accuracy splits. ScanQA is evaluated with exact match, BLEU-1, METEOR, and CIDEr; SQA3D [ 16 ] uses exact-match answer accuracy; and Scan2Cap [ 18 ] uses CIDEr, BLEU-4, METEOR, and ROUGE under IoU@0.5. We follow the benchmark protocols used by PQ3D [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们评价涉及四个任务家庭的八个公共基准的模型。 ScanNet200[8] 提供实例口罩,用AP、AP50、AP25以及头/常见/尾类AP进行评估。 ScanRefer [12],Nr3D [11],Sr3D [11],和Multi3Drefer [14] 以标准精度分解来评价语言引导本地化. ScanQA以精确匹配,BLEU-1,METEOR,和CIDEr进行评价;SQA3D [16]使用精确匹配的答案精度;Scan2Cap [18]使用CIDEr,BLEU-4,METEOR,以及IoU@0.5下的ROUGE. 我们遵循PQ3D[28]使用的基准协议.

blocks.en: The training procedure consists of two stages. In the first stage, we train the model with instance segmentation alone on ScanNet200 for 800 epochs, using a classification head on instance queries instead of prompting object categories, and we guide the first 200 epochs with ground truth mask guidance [ 44 ] to speed convergence. In the second stage, we continue training on the full training set with all objectives for 50 epochs. We optimize with AdamW at a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , batch size of 16, β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , and β 2 = 0.98 \beta_{2}=0.98 , applying a cosine decay learning rate scheduler. We follow the data augmentation strategy of PQ3D [ 28 ] , including geometric transformations and color augmentation during training. We set the number of queries to 120 to balance inference speed and the number of objects in the scene. All training is run on 4 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

blocks.en: V-B Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: V-B 定性结果

blocks.en: Figures 4 and 5 present qualitative results across the four evaluated task families. In Figure 4 , for instance segmentation, our model responds to both explicit category prompts, such as “Printer” and “Drawer”, and more functional descriptions, such as “I want to wash fruit”, demonstrating consistent language-conditioned scene understanding. In visual grounding, the advantage is more evident for expressions that require spatial disambiguation among nearby objects. For example, for “the black trash can under the table” and “the first chair from the right”, our predictions align more closely with the ground-truth regions than those of PQ3D, suggesting better use of relational cues beyond object semantics. Similar behavior is observed in question answering in Figure 5 , where egocentric questions involving directions such as left, behind, and across require reasoning with respect to the specified viewpoint; our predictions more consistently identify the corresponding answer-relevant objects. The dense-captioning examples further reveal differences in semantic and spatial understanding. PQ3D confuses the Pepsi vending machine with a refrigerator and the brown table with a shelf, whereas our model correctly identifies the object categories while retaining relevant attributes and spatial relations. For the washing-machine example, our description additionally captures its white, rectangular appearance and its location in the middle of the room. These examples qualitatively support the model’s ability to associate language with object identity, attributes, and spatial structure across different 3D vision-language tasks.
blocks.zh: 图4和图5列出了四个受评价任务组的质量结果。 例如,在图4中,我们的模型既响应“Printer”和“Drawer”等明确类别的提示,又响应“我想洗水果”等功能描述,表明对语言条件一致的场景理解。 在视觉地面上,对于需要附近物体间空间分化的表达方式来说,优势更为明显. 例如,对于“桌子底下的黑垃圾”和“右侧第一主席”,我们的预测与地面真实区域比PQ3D更接近,表明在物体语义之外更好地利用关系提示。 类似的行为在回答问题时在图5中观察到,其中涉及诸如左侧、后侧和跨侧方向的自我中心问题要求对特定观点进行推理;我们的预测更一致地确定相应的答案相关对象。 密集的封装例子进一步揭示了语义和空间理解的差异. PQ3D将百事自动售票机与冰箱,棕色桌子与货架混为一谈,而我们的模型在保留相关属性和空间关系的同时正确识别对象类别. 以洗衣机为例,我们的描述还额外描述了它的白色,长方形外观及其位于房间中部的位置. 这些例子在质量上支持了模型将语言与不同三维视觉语言任务中的对象身份,属性和空间结构联系起来的能力.

blocks.en: V-C Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: V-C 量化结果

blocks.en: As shown in Table I , our method achieves the best performance among the compared methods on ScanNet200 across all evaluation metrics. Compared with representative methods such as ISBNet [ 66 ] , Mask3D [ 27 ] , and PQ3D [ 28 ] , our approach improves the overall Average Precision (AP) from 27.0 to 30.2, and further increases AP 50 \mathrm{AP}_{50} and AP 25 \mathrm{AP}_{25} from 38.9 and 46.3 to 41.6 and 48.8, respectively. In terms of long-tailed class performance, our method substantially improves the head-class AP to 52.7, surpassing PQ3D by 16.9 points, while also improving the common and tail categories from 24.2 and 20.0 to 26.7 and 21.4.
blocks.zh: 如表一所示,在ScanNet 200上的比较方法中,我们的方法在所有评价指标中都取得了最佳业绩。 与ISBNet[66]、Mask3D[27]和PQ3D[28]等代表性方法相比,我们的方法将总体平均精度从27.0提高到30.2,并进一步将AP 50\mathrm{AP}_{50}和AP 25\mathrm{AP}_{25}分别从38.9和46.3提高到41.6和48.8。 在长尾类性能方面,我们的方法大大改进了头级AP到52.7,超过PQ3D16.9分,同时也改进了常见和尾类,从24.2和20.0到26.7和21.4.

blocks.en: Unlike approaches that directly operate on individual or heterogeneous representations, our method explicitly establishes cross-representation correspondence before their joint use. Triple Alignment first aligns spatially corresponding features, after which representation-specific orthogonal re-parameterisation enables controlled adaptation while preserving intra-representation geometry, followed by adaptive fusion under downstream supervision. The consistent improvements across head, common, and tail categories demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating complementary representations within this align-then-fuse framework.
blocks.zh: 与直接处理个别或不同表述的方法不同,我们的方法在共同使用之前明确确定了交叉表述的函证。 三对齐首先对应于空间对应特征,之后代表特异性的正交重参数化使得在保持代表内几何的同时能够进行有控制的适应,然后在下游监督下进行适应性聚变. 头类、共同类和尾类的不断改进表明,将互补表述纳入这一协调框架是有效的。

blocks.en: As shown in Table II , we evaluate grounding accuracy on four benchmark datasets, including ScanRefer, Nr3D, Sr3D, and Multi3DRefer. Compared with PQ3D, our method improves the average accuracy by 2.9, 10.6, and 4.6 points on ScanRefer, Nr3D, and Sr3D, respectively. On Multi3DRefer, the average accuracy increases from 50.1 to 54.2, with the ST and MT scores improving from 43.6 and 40.9 to 48.2 and 46.5, respectively. For the ZT setting, our method achieves 59.3, improving upon PQ3D’s 57.7 but remaining below the best result of 66.9 from 3DJCG. Overall, the consistent gains across the four grounding benchmarks indicate that explicitly aligning heterogeneous scene representations before their controlled adaptation and fusion is particularly beneficial for language-conditioned object localization.
blocks.zh: 如表二所示,我们评价四个基准数据集的精确度,包括ScanRefer、Nr3D、Sr3D和Multi3Drefer。 与PQ3D相比,我们的方法在ScanRefer,Nr3D和Sr3D上分别提高了平均精度2.9,10.6和4.6分. 在Multi3Drefer中,平均精度从50.1提高到54.2,ST和MT的分数分别从43.6和40.9提高到48.2和46.5。 就 ZT 设置而言, 我们的方法达到了 59.3 , 比 PQ3D 的 57.7 有所改进,但仍低于 3DJCG 的 66.9 的最佳结果。 总体而言,四个基准的一致收益表明,在有控制的适应和融合之前明确调整不同的场景表现,对语言条件的物体本地化特别有利。

blocks.en: As shown in Table III , our method achieves the best overall results on ScanQA across both exact-match and language-generation metrics. On the ‘test with object” split, our model improves EM@1 from the previous best of 27.0 to 28.2, while increasing BLEU-1, METEOR, and CIDEr over PQ3D from 43.0, 17.8, and 87.8 to 46.4, 19.6, and 89.4, respectively. On the ‘test without object” split, EM@1 increases from 23.0 to 23.5, while BLEU-1, METEOR, and CIDEr improve from 36.1, 13.9, and 65.2 to 38.0, 16.5, and 67.3. These improvements show that the benefit of combining aligned complementary representations extends beyond object localization to language-conditioned scene reasoning.
blocks.zh: 如表三所示,我们的方法在ScanQA方面,在精确匹配和语言生成指标方面,取得了最佳的总体结果。 在 " 与物体试验 " 分开时,我们的模型将EM@1从以前的27.0改进为28.2,同时将BLEU-1、METEOR和CDEr分别从43.0、17.8和87.8改进为46.4、19.6和89.4。 在“无物体试验”分拆时,EM@1从23.0增加到23.5,而BLEU-1、METEOR和CIDER则从36.1、13.9和65.2增加到38.0、16.5和67.3。 这些改进表明,结合一致互补表述的好处超越了对象本地化,而扩展到了语言条件的场景推理.

blocks.en: On SQA3D, our method achieves the highest average accuracy of 48.7, slightly exceeding the previous best result of 48.5. It also obtains the best performance for the ‘Is” and ‘Other” question categories, reaching 63.9 and 50.8, respectively, while remaining competitive across the other question types. Although the overall improvement is modest compared with that observed on the grounding benchmarks, the results indicate that the proposed representation integration strategy remains effective for situated question answering without uniformly improving every question category.
blocks.zh: 在SQA3D上,我们的方法实现了48.7的最高平均精度,略高于之前48.5的最佳结果. 它还为“Is”和“其他”问题类别获得最佳业绩,分别达到63.9和50.8,同时在其他问题类别中保持竞争力。 虽然总体改善幅度与实地基准相比不大,但结果表明,拟议的代表一体化战略对于确定问题的答案依然有效,而没有统一改进每个问题类别。

blocks.en: As shown in Table IV , our method achieves the best performance among the compared approaches across all four Scan2Cap metrics. Compared with PQ3D, CIDEr increases from 80.3 to 81.2, BLEU-4 from 36.0 to 39.4, METEOR from 29.1 to 30.4, and ROUGE from 57.9 to 63.5. In particular, the larger gains on BLEU-4 and ROUGE indicate improved agreement between the generated descriptions and reference captions, while the improvements in CIDEr and METEOR further confirm the overall captioning quality. Together with the results on segmentation, grounding, and question answering, these results demonstrate that the proposed align-then-fuse formulation generalizes across both perception-oriented and language-generation tasks.
blocks.zh: 如表四所示,我们的方法在所有四个Scan2Cap指标的比较方法中取得了最佳业绩。 与PQ3D相比,CIDER从80.3增加到81.2,BLEU-4从36.0增加到39.4,METEOR从29.1增加到30.4,ROUGE从57.9增加到63.5. 特别是,BLEU-4和ROUGE的较大收益表明,生成的描述和参考标题之间更加一致,而CIDER和METEOR的改进进一步证实了总体标题的质量。 这些结果,连同关于分化、基础和回答问题的结果,表明拟议中的配方(当时的配方)概括了面向感官和语言生成的任务。

blocks.zh: V-D 读取研究

blocks.en: Figure 6 provides an illustration of the effect of introducing the Triple Alignment module on the feature distributions across different representations. In the original setting, observable discrepancies exist among the representations, as reflected by differences in peak position and distribution width. After introducing Triple Alignment, the density curves become more consistent in both peak location and distribution width, indicating reduced representation discrepancy in the latent space. This observation is consistent with the role of Triple Alignment in establishing correspondence among spatially corresponding scene features. As shown in Table VI , introducing Triple Alignment alone improves the visual grounding accuracy over the baseline by 2.1, 5.1, 0.8, and 3.0 points on ScanRefer, Nr3D, Sr3D, and Multi3DRefer, respectively. When Orthogonal Fusion is already enabled, further introducing Triple Alignment still yields improvements of 1.3, 1.9, 0.6, and 2.3 points on the four benchmarks. These results demonstrate that explicitly establishing segment-level correspondence before fusion consistently benefits language-conditioned object localization.
blocks.zh: 图6说明了采用三重组合模块对不同表述特点分布的影响。 在最初的设定中,各表述之间存在明显的差异,这体现在高峰位置和分布宽度的差异上. 在引入三叠纪后,密度曲线在峰值位置和分布宽度上更加一致,表明潜在空间的表示差异减小. 这种观察与三重校正在建立空间对应场景特征之间的对应作用是一致的. 如表六所示,单采用三聚对齐法就能在ScanRefer、Nr3D、Sr3D和Multi3Drefer上分别提高基线的视觉地面定位精度2.1、5.1、0.8和3.0点。 当正统融合已经启用时,进一步采用三联调制仍然使四个基准的改进率达到1.3、1.9、0.6和2.3分。 这些结果表明,在聚变之前明确建立分层通信,始终有利于语言条件对象本地化。

blocks.en: Figure 7 qualitatively illustrates the effect of Orthogonal Fusion on multi-representation feature coordination. We fit bivariate polynomial surfaces to features extracted from the image, point-cloud, and voxel representations for representative examples, comparing the variant without Orthogonal Fusion with the full model. After orthogonal re-parameterisation, the fitted surfaces generally exhibit greater overlap, providing a qualitative indication that the representation-specific features are more consistently coordinated before fusion. Importantly, this effect does not imply that the three representations are forced into an identical feature distribution. Instead, the orthogonal transformations provide representation-specific adaptation while preserving pairwise distances and inner products within each representation.
blocks.zh: 图7从质量上说明了正统融合对多代表特征协调的影响。 我们把从图像中提取的特性, 点- 云, 和 voxel 表示来作为代表性的例子, 将没有 Orthogonal Fusion 的变体与完整的模型进行比较。 整形再参数化后,装配的表面通常出现较大的重叠,从质量上表明,在聚变之前,代表特性的协调更加一致。 重要的是,这种效果并不意味着这三种表述被迫进行相同的特征分配。 相反,正交转换提供了针对代表的适应,同时在每个代表中保留对等距离和内产物。

blocks.en: The quantitative results further support this observation. As shown in Table V , introducing Orthogonal Fusion alone improves AP, AP 50 , and AP 25 on ScanNet200 by 2.8, 2.4, and 1.3 points, respectively. Similar improvements are observed for visual grounding: compared with the baseline, Orthogonal Fusion alone improves performance by 1.6, 8.7, 4.0, and 1.8 points on ScanRefer, Nr3D, Sr3D, and Multi3DRefer, respectively. On ScanQA ( Table VII ), it improves BLEU-1 by 3.4/2.4 points and CIDEr by 0.7/1.9 points on the test sets with/without object annotations. The results on SQA3D ( Table VIII ) and Scan2Cap ( Table IX ) further show that both components provide complementary benefits across question answering and captioning, although neither consistently dominates every individual metric. Together, these results suggest that geometry-preserving re-parameterisation provides effective representation-specific adaptation before cross-representation fusion.
blocks.zh: 量化结果进一步证实了这一看法。 如表五所示,仅采用Orthogonal Fusion就可以使ScanNet200上的AP、AP 50和AP 25分别提高2.8、2.4和1.3分。 在视觉地面上也观察到了类似的改进:与基线相比,仅Orthogonal Fusion在ScanRefer、Nr3D、Sr3D和Multi3Drefer上的性能分别提高了1.6、8.7、4.0和1.8点。 在ScanQA(表七)上,它改进了BLEU-1的3.4/2.4分,在测试集上用/无对象说明改进了0.7/1.9分。 关于SQA3D(表八)和Scan2Cap(表九)的结果进一步表明,这两个组成部分在回答问题和标题方面都提供了互补的好处,尽管两者都无法始终主宰每个衡量标准。 这些结果共同表明,几何-保定再参数化在交叉表示聚变之前,提供了有效的代表特异性的适应.

blocks.en: As shown in Table X to XIV , we systematically compare our adaptive fusion with alternative multi-representation fusion strategies based on element-wise addition ( ⊕ \oplus ) and feature concatenation followed by projection ( ⊗ \otimes ).
blocks.zh: 如表十至十四所示,我们系统地将适应性聚变与基于元素加成(QQ\oplus)和特征加成之后的预测(XQ\otions)的替代多代表聚变战略进行比较。

blocks.en: Our Adaptive Fusion achieves the strongest overall performance across the evaluated tasks. It obtains the best results on all three ScanNet200 metrics and on three of the four visual-grounding benchmarks, while full concatenation performs best on Multi3DRefer with 55.1. A similar pattern is observed for the language tasks: Adaptive Fusion achieves the best or tied-best results across the ScanQA metrics and the highest average accuracy of 48.7 on SQA3D. On Scan2Cap, it achieves the best BLEU-4 and METEOR scores of 39.4 and 30.4, whereas full concatenation obtains slightly higher CIDEr and ROUGE scores of 81.6 and 63.8.
blocks.zh: 我们的适应性融合在评价任务中取得了最强的整体业绩。 它在所有三个ScanNet200度量衡和四个可视化基准中的三个度量衡上都取得了最佳效果,而全凝聚则在Multi3DREFer上以55.1度度度量衡表现最好. 语言任务也观察到类似的模式:适应性融合在ScanQA的测量中达到最佳或捆绑的最佳结果,在SQA3D上达到48.7的最高平均精度. 在Scan2Cap上,它取得了最佳的BLEU-4和METEOR分数39.4和30.4,而完全协和则获得略高的CIDER和ROUGE分数81.6和63.8.

blocks.en: Overall, full concatenation generally performs better than direct element-wise addition, suggesting that simply combining the representations with equal contribution is insufficient. In comparison, our Adaptive Fusion assigns normalized learnable coefficients to the transformed representations and optimizes their relative contributions jointly under downstream task supervision. Its consistently strong performance across different task families supports the use of learned representation coordination after alignment and orthogonal re-parameterisation, while the few metrics favoring concatenation also indicate that no single fusion rule uniformly dominates every evaluation setting.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,完全结合一般比直接要素加法做得更好,说明仅仅将表述与同等贡献结合起来是不够的。 相比之下,我们的适应性融合为转变后的表述分配了正常的可学习系数,并在下游任务监督下共同优化了它们的相对贡献。 它对不同任务家庭的一贯有力业绩支持在调整和正统再参数化后使用已学到的代表权协调,而少数有利于合并的衡量标准也表明,没有单一的聚变规则统一支配每个评价环境。

blocks.en: We further compare the computational complexity of our method with PQ3D under prompt-conditioned inference. As shown in Table XV , PQ3D contains 247.88M parameters and requires 25.81 GFLOPs for a single forward pass, whereas our model contains 254.95M parameters and requires 26.94 GFLOPs. This corresponds to an increase of approximately 7.08M parameters (2.9%) and 1.13 GFLOPs (4.4%), respectively. The inference time increases from 0.1340 s to 0.1648 s per forward pass, corresponding to an additional 0.0308 s (23.0%). The additional inference cost mainly arises from the representation-specific orthogonal re-parameterisation and Adaptive Fusion operations. Overall, our method introduces a modest increase in model complexity while consistently improving performance across the evaluated 3D vision-language tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将方法的计算复杂性与PQ3D进行快速的推论比较. 如表十五所示,PQ3D包含247.88M参数,单一前传需要25.81GFLOP,而我们的模型包含254.95M参数,需要26.94GFLOP. 这相当于分别增加了大约7.08M参数(2.9%)和1.13GFLOP(4.4%)。 推断时间从每前传0.1340秒增加到0.1648秒,相当于额外0.0308秒(23.0%). 额外的推论费用主要来自代表特异性的正向再参数化和适应性融合操作. 总的来说,我们的方法在模型复杂性方面略有增加,同时不断改进所评价的3D远景语言任务的业绩。

blocks.en: VI Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The results support a specific proposition: alignment and fusion solve different parts of heterogeneous representation integration. Triple Alignment improves cross-representation correspondence before task decoding, whereas Orthogonal Fusion restricts the subsequent re-parameterisation so that it does not alter pairwise distances or inner products within each representation. Their combination is consistently strongest in the visual-grounding ablation, although the ablations across the remaining tasks show that neither component dominates every individual metric. These findings should be interpreted within the tested indoor-scene benchmarks and pretrained feature pipelines.
blocks.zh: 这些结果支持一项具体提议:调整和组合解决了不同代表性整合的不同部分。 三联调制改进了任务解码前的交叉表示式函式,而正交调制则限制后续的重新参数化,使其不改变每个表示式的双向距离或内产物. 它们的组合在视觉测底衰竭中始终是最强的,尽管在剩余任务中的浮雕表明,两个部分都不支配每个指标。 这些调查结果应在经过测试的室内场地基准和预先训练的地物管道内加以解释。

blocks.en: The method relies on pretrained, representation-specific encoders and therefore does not establish fully end-to-end cross-representation learning. Orthogonal re-parameterisation and Adaptive Fusion introduce additional inference cost: relative to PQ3D, the measured model has 254.95M rather than 247.88M parameters, 26.94 rather than 25.81 GFLOPs, and a 0.1648-s rather than 0.1340-s forward pass. Evaluation is limited to the eight reported datasets, which largely share indoor-scene structure; robustness to outdoor scenes, missing representations, and sensor corruption remains untested. These limitations motivate more efficient representation adaptation and fusion, as well as explicit evaluation under missing-representation settings.
blocks.zh: 这种方法依赖于经过预先训练的,具有代表性的特异性编码器,因此没有建立完全的端到端的交叉表示学习. 矫形再参数化和适应性融合引入了额外的推论成本:相对于PQ3D,所测模型有254.95M参数而非247.88M参数,26.94参数而非25.81GFLOPs参数,以及0.1648s而不是0.1340s前传. 评价仅限于所报告的8个数据集,它们基本上共享室内场景结构;室外场景的坚固度、缺失的表述和传感器腐败仍未经过测试。 这些限制促使更有效地调整和整合代表性,并在缺失代表性环境中进行明确评价。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We present an “ align-then-fuse " framework for 3D vision–language understanding that integrates point clouds, voxel grids, and multi-view images within a unified architecture. Our Triple Alignment establishes segment-level correspondence across heterogeneous representations before task decoding, while representation-specific orthogonal re-parameterisation enables controlled adaptation by preserving the pairwise geometry within each representation. The resulting features are then combined through Adaptive Fusion under downstream task supervision. Extensive experiments on eight datasets show that our model achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across tasks ranging from low-level segmentation to high-level reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了三维愿景-语言理解的 " 调和时调 " 框架,将点云、阴极网格和多视图图像融合在一个统一的架构内。 我们的三重校对在任务解码前建立不同表述的分层对应关系,而特定表述的正向再参数化则能够通过保留每个表述中的对等几何来进行有控制的调整。 然后,通过下游任务监督下的适应性融合,将由此产生的特征结合起来。 对8个数据集的广泛实验显示,我们的模型在从低层次分解到高层次推理的任务之间实现了竞争性或最先进的性能.
